settings.heading: Rooted in Bhadohi. Made for everywhere.
settings.intro: Shukla Rugs began with a belief that luxury should feel human.
settings.body: We bring together the textile heritage of North India and a modern, quietly confident point of view. Our rugs are designed to settle into a room, gather memories, and improve with time.

settings.heading: A sense of place
settings.text: Bhadohi has been a centre of carpet making for centuries.

settings.heading: A modern eye
settings.text: We edit tradition into pieces that feel at home today.

settings.heading: A lasting relationship
settings.text: The best rug is one that becomes part of your everyday.
